crossRefs.note: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a…
The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”
Many of them said, “He has a demon, and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”
But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in…
Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

translations.web: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”
translations.bsb: So the Jews began to ask, “Will He kill Himself, since He says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?”
translations.kjv: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
translations.asv: The Jews therefore said, Will he kill himself, that he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come?
